# A Philosophy of Software Design for Gemini CLI

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/philosophy-of-design/ in the guided-plugins repository.

Install from a checkout of the repository (Gemini installs one extension per repository from GitHub, so use the local path):

```bash
gemini extensions install ./dist/gemini/philosophy-of-design
```

- 36 skills (including 6 mode skills), each also a slash command `/philosophy-of-design:philosophy-of-design-<name>`.
- 22 subagents, started with `@philosophy-of-design-<name> <task>`.
